error_reason: The Planner erroneously interpreted 'where Robert Khayat was educated' as his alma mater (University of Mississippi School of Law) instead of his long-standing career role as Chancellor at the general University of Mississippi. This misalignment between the fact (Chancellor) and the event (graduate/alum) fundamentally altered the search query, leading the WebSurfer to search for the first Black student at the Law School (Cleve McDowell) rather than the university as a whole (James Meredith).
